title: A constructible finite source is generically lisse
statement: Let $S$ be an integral Noetherian affine scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $g:Z\to S$ be finite, and let $E$ be an abelian etale sheaf whose underlying set sheaf is constructible [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. There exists a dense open $U\subseteq S$ such that the underlying set sheaf of the abelian inverse image $E|_{g^{-1}(U)}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is finite locally constant [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves].

source.place: ## Proof, first three paragraphs (closedness, reduction, generic lisse source)

proof.text: Unpack constructibility to choose a lisse stratification T. Let W be the union of the interiors of its strata. Its abelian restriction has lisse underlying sets by the stratum-interiors lemma. The generic-fibre lemma shows that W contains every point over the generic point of S.

Define U as the complement of the image under g of the closed complement of W. A finite map is integral and universally closed, so U is open. Generic-fibre containment says that U contains the generic point of S; closure of that singleton is all of S, so U is dense. By definition, g inverse U is contained in W.

Pull back the lisse abelian restriction on W along the open inclusion g inverse U to W. The composite with W to Z is the canonical inclusion g inverse U to Z (Scheme.homOfLE_ι), giving exactly the required sheaf.

proof_origin.place: Proof paragraphs 1--3; use the interiors of the original constructible stratification, finite-fibre discreteness, closed-image shrinking and abelian pullback preservation.

constructible sheaf on a finite scheme over an integral base restricts to a finite locally constant sheaf over some dense open of the base

lean.statement:
theorem exists_dense_open_lisse_finite_source
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral S] [IsNoetherian S] [IsAffine S]
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ S) [IsFinite g]
    (E : Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hE : IsConstructibleEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((sheafCompose Z.smallEtaleTopology (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj E)) :
    ∃ U : S.Opens, Dense (U : Set S) ∧
      IsLisseEtaleSheafOfSets
        ((sheafCompose (g ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.smallEtaleTopology
          (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
            ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (g ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj E))
